item.title: Lara v0.2
item.description:
lara 0.2 | lara_v0.2
## UX Changes - Moved tweaks into its own accessible section, and put Tools there at the bottom. - Moved logs out of the tab bar and into a toolbar item at the top of the primary views (you can change this back in settings). - Settings has been completed reorganized, with some new customization toggles for the app itself.
## Applying/Handling - Fixed kernelcache weirdness (kernelcache is now fetched locally) - Hybrid will now be used by default.
## Tweaks - Rewrote MobileGestalt View + Added a ton of tweaks! (thanks @jurre111) - Rewrote Liquid Glass View with nice previewer. - Fixed Passcode + Add repo viewer (thanks @neonmodder123) - Add SpringBoard Customizer (thanks @leminlimez and Cowabunga, as well as @jurre111 for fixing the view) - Add SystemColor patcher.
